geometry.locator: arXiv:1508.03943 Table 2 (AD-to-core baselines); OSM reactor-building positions
geometry.note: Nonlinear least-squares multilateration (scipy.optimize.least_squares on raw Euclidean centre-to-centre distance residuals, local equirectangular projection) of this hall's position from the six Daya Bay/Ling Ao/Ling Ao-II reactor-core buildings (geometry:daya-bay-core-d1/d2, geometry:lingao-core-l1/l2, geometry:lingao-ii-core-l3/l4; accuracy_m 8 each), using the mean of this hall's antineutrino-detector(AD)-to-core-centre baselines from arXiv:1508.03943 Table 2 (survey uncertainty stated as < 18 mm) as the target distance to each core. Fit residual (measured centre-to-centre distance vs. the Table-2 mean) is under 5 m on every one of the six cores (max 0.4% of the baseline); accuracy_m is set well above that residual to also cover the buildings' own ~8 m footprint accuracy and the approximation of using each hall's own AD-mean baseline rather than a single physically-located point within the hall.
